description: Exposes one granted folder to any AI client, read-only, behind a path-containment fence.
name: com.wyrdmcp/wyrd

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the single folder to serve, read-only. Used when --grant is not passed. The server refuses to start if neither is set.
environmentVariables.name: WYRD_GRANT

packageArguments.description: Absolute path to the single folder to serve, read-only. Wins over WYRD_GRANT. Every file inside it is readable, including hidden ones — grant a subfolder containing only what you mean to share.
packageArguments.name: --grant
